name: Defend
doc: Defend (the command): the root and the director - the two shields in front of the caster (the large one shrinking onto him, the small one flickering), the sound; the action result. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag183_defend.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the module).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Director
parts.doc: The two shields in front of the caster (the large one shrinking onto him, the small one flickering), the sound; the action result

params.label: Sound
